front: What is the **statement of financial position**?
back: A statement of assets, liabilities and capital at a particular date.
Assets kept for more than a year to use in the business (premises, vehicles, equipment; intangible: goodwill).
Cash or items that become cash within a year: inventory, trade receivables, other receivables, bank, cash.
Opening capital + capital introduced + profit (− loss) − drawings.

front: Where does a bank overdraft go?

back: Cash/bank; goods (debit drawings, credit purchases, at cost); other assets; private expenses paid by the business.

front: Heading of a statement of financial position
back: Business name; Statement of financial position; at 31 December 2025.

front: Why must net assets equal closing capital?
back: The accounting equation: assets − liabilities = capital.
